articles.title: Thousands of Disability Complaints Dismissed as Civil Rights Office Shrinks
articles.summary: Budget cuts closed 7 of the Office for Civil Rights' 12 regional offices and left 446 staff. From March to September 2025, about 90% of the 7,000-plus complaints marked "resolved" were actually dismissed without investigation, a government watchdog found.

articles.title: Ukraine Airdrops Food by Drone to Starving Occupied City
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones dropped four tonnes of food at 100 locations in Oleshky, a Russian-occupied city where about 6,000 people remain. Officials say residents have been reduced to foraging for weeds, and Russia is accused of blocking aid.

articles.title: Venezuela Releases Political Prisoners as Calls for Elections Grow
articles.summary: Venezuela freed a group of political prisoners Saturday, days after interim President Delcy Rodríguez met President Trump. Rights group Foro Penal says the release scheme stopped with less than half of the country's political prisoners freed, and the opposition now wants elections.
